title: Fluxer theme entry
description: Describes one theme folder and the variants inside it.

name.description: Display name of the theme family, for example Gruvbox.

description.description: One or two sentences shown on the gallery card.

author.description: Whoever made it. A GitHub handle is fine.

homepage.description: Optional link to the upstream palette, repo, or post.

license.description: Optional SPDX identifier for the theme itself.

tags.description: Free form. Used for filtering, no fixed vocabulary.

name.description: Display name of this variant, for example Mocha.

file.description: Stylesheet filename, relative to the theme folder.

base.description: Which built in Fluxer theme this variant is designed to sit on top of. The preview loads that base first.

fluxerThemeId.description: Written by the publish workflow. The id returned by Fluxer when the stylesheet was uploaded, used to build the Open in Fluxer link. Do not set this by hand.

fluxerThemeHash.description: Written by the publish workflow. SHA-256 of the stylesheet at the time it was uploaded, so the workflow knows when to publish a new id.
